# The smallest pair the rank has to keep apart.
#
# Found by running the distinctness property against the bijection with the
# shift dropped, in tests/support/mod.rs. Without the shift both of the
# monomials below rank to 0, so one coefficient is read for the other and the
# series is wrong by an amount that looks like an answer.
#
# Three variables is the smallest width where the shift is visible at all: the
# k = 1 term carries a shift of zero, so a two variable case cannot tell the two
# implementations apart, and a suite that only went that far would have passed.

variables: 3
degree: 1

index: 0
exponents: 0 0 1

index: 1
exponents: 0 1 0
